mapper.select: SELECT T.TYPE_NO AS typeNo, G.GROUP_NAME AS groupName, T.TYPE_NAME AS typeName, COUNT(R.REPORT_NO) AS cnt FROM REPORT_TYPE T INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE_GROUP G ON T.GROUP_NO = G.GROUP_NO LEFT JOIN REPORT R ON R.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO GROUP BY T.TYPE_NO, G.GROUP_NAME, T.TYPE_NAME ORDER BY cnt DESC, T.TYPE_NO LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT G.GROUP_NO, G.GROUP_NAME, T.TYPE_NO, T.TYPE_NAME FROM REPORT_TYPE_GROUP G INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE T ON G.GROUP_NO = T.GROUP_NO ORDER BY G.GROUP_NO, T.TYPE_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT (MEMBER_NO, REPORTER_NAME, REPORTER_PHONE, TYPE_NO, ROUTE_NO, CONTENT) VALUES (#{memberNo}, #{reporterName}, #{reporterPhone}, #{typeNo}, #{routeNo}, #{content})
INSERT INTO REPORT_FILE (REPORT_NO, ORIGIN_NAME, SAVE_NAME, FILE_DESC, SORT_NO) VALUES (#{reportNo}, #{originName}, #{saveName}, #{fileDesc}, #{sortNo})
mapper.select:
SELECT R.REPORT_NO, R.MEMBER_NO, R.REPORTER_NAME, R.REPORTER_PHONE, R.TYPE_NO, R.ROUTE_NO, R.CONTENT, R.STATUS, R.REG_DATE, G.GROUP_NAME, T.TYPE_NAME, CASE R.STATUS WHEN 'RECEIVED' THEN '접수' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN '처리중' WHEN 'DONE' THEN '완료' ELSE R.STATUS END AS STATUS_NAME FROM REPORT R INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE T ON R.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE_GROUP G ON T.GROUP_NO = G.GROUP_NO
ORDER BY R.REPORT_NO ASC
ORDER BY R.REPORT_NO DESC
LIMIT #{displayDataCnt} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT R.REPORT_NO, R.MEMBER_NO, R.REPORTER_NAME, R.REPORTER_PHONE, R.TYPE_NO, R.ROUTE_NO, R.CONTENT, R.STATUS, R.REG_DATE, R.ANSWER, R.ANSWER_DATE, G.GROUP_NAME, T.TYPE_NAME, CASE R.STATUS WHEN 'RECEIVED' THEN '접수' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN '처리중' WHEN 'DONE' THEN '완료' ELSE R.STATUS END AS STATUS_NAME FROM REPORT R INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE T ON R.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE_GROUP G ON T.GROUP_NO = G.GROUP_NO WHERE R.REPORT_NO = #{reportNo} AND R.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT FILE_NO, REPORT_NO, ORIGIN_NAME, SAVE_NAME, FILE_DESC, SORT_NO FROM REPORT_FILE WHERE REPORT_NO = #{reportNo} ORDER BY SORT_NO
SELECT ROUTE_NO, ROUTE_NAME FROM BUS_ROUTE WHERE ROUTE_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ROUTE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY ROUTE_NO LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUS_ROUTE WHERE ROUTE_NO = #{routeNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM REPORT WHERE REPORT_NO = #{reportNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND STATUS = 'RECEIVED'
